summary: E-commerce app for Swapan Store selling Indian masalas, groceries, and food oils

existing_features.title: Create a product listing page that displays all available products organized by categories (masalas, groceries, food oils) with product images, names, prices, and add-to-cart buttons
Build a shopping cart page that displays added items with quantities, individual prices, total price, and options to update quantities or remove items

Design a vibrant, warm color scheme inspired by Indian spice markets with earthy tones, rich accent colors, and clear typography that evokes traditional Indian grocery stores while maintaining modern usability
Create a storefront header with the Swapan Store branding, navigation menu, and shopping cart icon with item count badge
Display generated product images for masalas, groceries, and food oils as static assets in the product catalog
Create an admin dashboard route at /admin that displays all products in a table format with columns for product image, name, category, current price in Indian Rupees (₹), and action buttons
Add an 'Edit Price' button or inline edit capability for each product in the admin dashboard that allows updating the price value
Display all prices throughout the application (product listing page, cart page, admin dashboard) in Indian Rupees format with the ₹ symbol prefix
Add navigation link to the admin dashboard in the header navigation menu
Create a login page component at /admin/login route that displays a password input field and submit button with Swapan Store branding consistent with the existing design theme
Implement authentication flow that redirects unauthenticated users from /admin to /admin/login and allows access to admin dashboard only after successful password verification
Add a logout capability to the admin dashboard header that clears authentication state and redirects to /admin/login
Create a checkout page component at /checkout route that displays cart summary, input fields for phone number and delivery address, order total in Indian Rupees, and a 'Place Order' button

Implement checkout flow that calls the backend order creation function with phone number and address, clears the cart on success, and displays confirmation message 'Your order will be delivered today!'
Add 'Proceed to Checkout' button to the cart page that navigates to /checkout route when cart has items

Add an Orders section to the admin dashboard that displays all customer orders in a table with columns for order date/time, customer phone number, delivery address, items ordered, and total price in Indian Rupees
Create a React Query hook for placing orders that calls the backend order creation function and invalidates cart queries on success
Create a React Query hook for fetching all orders in the admin dashboard that calls the backend orders query function

new_feature_requests.summary: E-commerce storefront for Indian masalas, groceries, and food oils
Create a product catalog system in the backend to store and manage products including Indian masalas, groceries, and food oils with fields for name, description, price, category, and image URL
Implement a shopping cart system in the backend that allows users to add products, update quantities, and retrieve cart contents

Populate the product catalog with sample data for at least 12 products across the three categories: Indian masalas (turmeric, cumin, garam masala, red chili powder), groceries (rice, lentils, flour, chickpeas), and food oils (mustard oil, coconut oil, sunflower oil, sesame oil)
Admin dashboard to manage products with ability to edit prices displayed in Indian Rupees (₹)
Implement a backend function to update product prices that accepts a product ID and new price value, validates the input, and persists the change to the product catalog
Add password authentication to admin dashboard access with password 'anugou9995'
Add a backend function to verify admin password that accepts a password string and returns true if it matches 'anugou9995', false otherwise
Create a checkout page that collects customer address and phone number
Display customer orders with address and phone number in the admin dashboard
Show confirmation message to customer that product will be delivered today after checkout
Create an Order data type in the backend that stores customer phone number, delivery address, order items (product IDs and quantities), total price, order timestamp, and caller Principal
Implement a backend function to create and store orders that accepts phone number, address, and cart items, calculates total price, and persists the order with caller Principal and current timestamp
Add a backend query function to retrieve all orders for the admin dashboard that returns array of orders with customer details, items, and totals
